references.title: Calle 24 Special Area Design Guidelines
observations: Neighborhood signs include awnings, painted signs and multilingual business identity.
Laundromat examples combine an overhead identity band and limited window lettering.

references.title: Commercial laundromat planning and design
references.location: Product reference; dimensions remain inference priors
observations: Store dimensions, windows, doors, utilities and equipment mix are planned together.
Folding tables, seating, machine banks and utility schedules are distinct program elements.

references.title: Five laundromat design lessons
references.location: Product reference; dimensions remain inference priors
observations: Overcrowding is a common error; irregular and narrow stores require different arrangements.
Sightlines from storefront windows into aisles are useful in unattended stores.
